# lol.trq.lazarus

> Launch runtime that boots stock Minecraft Forge 1.8.9 on Java 17 to 25 by patching LaunchWrapper, FML and Mixin
> behaviour at runtime. LGPL-3.0-or-later. Pre-alpha.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): goals, roadmap, build, credits
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): mental model, patterns that matter, traps
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): release notes
- [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md): commit, license-header and test conventions
- [NOTICE](NOTICE.md): bundled third-party code

## Core source

- [Classpath](src/main/java/lol/trq/lazarus/launch/Classpath.java): `java.class.path` as URLs

## Examples

- [ClasspathTest](src/test/java/lol/trq/lazarus/launch/ClasspathTest.java): parsing and de-duplication
